verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product, so letting it consume external MCP servers' tools is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents cubic's own MCP server, which coding agents connect to (the server role). It shows nothing about cubic acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
